vts_boundary_basis: Not inside any statutory VTS service area: Sjøtrafikkforskriften §6 lists six areas (Horten, Brevik, Kvitsøy, Fedje, Kinn, Melkøya) and Kystverket's official VTS-area polygons (R-S7) do not overlap this TSS (R-S6 polygons). Vardø VTS centre (NOR VTS) monitoring and information service for the offshore TSS is recorded as a lead, not as VTS coverage.
reporting_scheme_name: Mandatory ship reporting system In the Barents Area (BARENTS SRS)
reporting_authority: Norwegian Coastal Administration (Kystverket), Vardø VTS centre (NOR VTS) for the Norwegian monitoring area
reporting_boundary_basis: Kystverket names the TSS from Vardø to Røst as inside the Barents SRS operational area (R-S2). Independently, every lane and separation-zone polygon of this TSS (Kystverket WFS, R-S6; extent 70°42'N to 70°53'N, 031°25'E to 031°59'E) lies landward of the MSC.348(91) seaward limit A to H (R-S1), minimum margin about 22.6 nm (rhumb-line test), and north of 67°10'N. Full inclusion.
evidence_summary: IMO B-II/19 'Off the coast of Norway' component, part of the former 2007 'Vardø to Røst' system (consolidated 1 June 2021, R-S10). Inside BARENTS SRS (VRS-0009): Kystverket states the Vardø to Røst TSS are within its operational area and the Kystverket TSS polygons fall inside the MSC.348(91) boundary. Ships of 5,000 GT and above, all tankers, hazardous cargo ships etc. report to Vardø VTS centre. No statutory VTS area covers the TSS; NOR VTS monitors routeing-measure traffic as an information service outside VTS areas. Pass 4: the Regulation on vessels' notification obligations (21 Dec 2015 no. 1790) confirms the only transit reporting duty is Barents SRS (chapter 7), southern limit 67 10 N.
source_date: MSC.348(91) 28 Nov 2012 (in force 1 June 2013); Sjøtrafikkforskriften consolidated to FOR-2026-06-29-1454; VTS-area polygons valid from 2021-04-01; accessed 29 Sep 2026
unresolved_issue: Project rule needed: NOR VTS (Vardø) monitors routeing measures outside the statutory VTS areas; if that counts as VTS coverage, all 19 Norwegian TSS move up one class.
